## REQUIREMENTS

### 1. SuperAdmin

* Has ALL privileges
* Privileges MUST still be explicitly checked (no bypass)
* Every new feature MUST register its privileges for the SuperAdmin

---

### 2. Privilege Model

* Privilege = ACTION + RESOURCE
* Examples:

  * USER_CREATE
  * USER_VIEW
  * ORDER_APPROVE

---

### 3. Privilege Pools

#### Global (SuperAdmin)

* Defines master privilege pool

#### Tenant Admin

* Can:

  * Create roles
  * Assign privileges from allowed pool
  * Define tenant-specific privilege pools
* Constraint:

  * Tenant pools ⊆ SuperAdmin pool

---

### 4. Enforcement Rules

* All API endpoints MUST check privileges
* No endpoint without authorization check
* No hardcoded role checks (use privileges only)
* Auth abuse protection (MANDATORY):
  - Rate limiting / brute-force protection for login and other auth endpoints
  - Explicit error/response behavior when rate limited (no info leaks)

---

### 5. Data Model

Define:

* users
* roles
* privileges
* role_privileges
* user_roles
* privilege_pools (global + tenant)

---

### 6. Liquibase Requirement

* ALL schema and privilege changes MUST be implemented via Liquibase changesets
* No manual DB updates
* Your agreed database migration standard is the authoritative rule set for Liquibase usage
* Any DML changeset MUST use a custom Java class extending CustomDataTaskChange

---
